original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.

actual_scope: Bounded content-keyed span reuse in the complete unchanged PR3240 R2 path-copy replay, preserving the complete scientific result, mutant inventory, exact rejection messages and operator decisions.
scope_change_reason: The runtime card is narrowed to the explicit remaining source/frame/event reconstruction handoff in PR3240. The predecessor mathematical result is cited, not audited.

stop_rule: Stop at the first verified complete-caller improvement; no follow-on optimization.
evidence: BENCHMARK.json binds fresh-process timings to exact source and implementation hashes. verify.py checks complete scientific equality and cache invalidation in normal and optimized modes.
